title: Intro to React: Build Your First Component
description: A hands-on beginner session on components, props, and state.
details: Bring your laptop with Node.js installed. We'll build a small interactive page from scratch and deploy it before the session ends. No prior React experience needed.

title: Flutter Study Jam
description: Build a simple cross-platform mobile app with Flutter.
details: We'll walk through widgets, layouts, and navigation, then build a small app together. Android Studio or VS Code with Flutter installed is recommended.

title: Cloud Study Jam: Deploying on Google Cloud
description: Deploy your first app to the cloud, step by step.
details: A guided lab covering cloud basics, hosting a small web app, and understanding how cloud services are billed. Free-tier accounts are enough for everything we do.

title: Getting Started with the Gemini API
description: Add AI features to a small app using a hosted model API.
details: Learn how to write good prompts, call a model from JavaScript, and handle responses safely. We'll finish with a tiny AI-powered tool you can extend on your own.

title: UI/UX Design Sprint
description: Go from idea to clickable prototype in one afternoon.
details: Teams of three or four will pick a problem, sketch solutions, and build a Figma prototype. Bring ideas; we'll bring the structure and feedback.

title: Breaking into Tech: Internship Panel
description: Students and alumni share how they landed tech internships.
details: Hear real stories, portfolio tips, and interview advice, followed by an open Q&A. A good session if you're just starting to apply.

title: Git & GitHub Workshop
description: Version control essentials every developer needs.
details: Learn commits, branches, pull requests, and how to collaborate without breaking each other's code. We'll finish by publishing a project to GitHub Pages.

title: Android Basics with Kotlin
description: Write and run your first native Android app.
details: A gentle introduction to Kotlin syntax, activities, and layouts using Android Studio. Emulators can be slow, so bring a physical Android phone if you have one.

title: GDGoC Welcome Mixer
description: Meet the new team and other tech-curious students.
details: An informal kickoff for the new session: meet the leads, hear what's planned, and find people to build with.

title: HTML & CSS Bootcamp
description: Build and style a responsive web page from zero.
details: A beginner-friendly bootcamp covering semantic HTML, the box model, flexbox, and responsive layouts. Everyone left with a finished personal page.
